card.name: Unit pieces right before a slash
card.fires_on: The last piece of a lab-value unit just before a slash, such as g in g/L, mmol in mmol/L, or mEq in mEq/L, after a number in lab thresholds. Also a day number before a slash in a date.

modes.label: Lab units before /L or /dL
modes.description: The unit piece after a serum value, right before the slash and the volume.
modes.example: serum sodium lower than 110 mm<<ol>>/L have been reported

modes.label: Grams per volume
modes.description: The letter g after an albumin number, before /L or /dL.
modes.example: serum albumin concentration less than 3.5<< g>>/dL, the maximum initial total daily

modes.label: Date before slash
modes.description: The day digits in a date, before the slash and year.

card.plain: It fires on the unit in a lab value, like the g or mmol, when a slash and the volume are about to follow.
